summary_en: 517,553 ordinary shares to be cancelled, representing 3.77% of issued shares before cancellation. Effective date 2026-07-10. Post-cancellation issued shares 13,210,000. Decision by Board on 2026-06-30 pursuant to Companies Act Article 178.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Wesco Holdings Inc. announced on 2026-06-30 that its Board of Directors has resolved to cancel 517,553 treasury shares of common stock. The cancellation is authorized under Companies Act Article 178 and will be effective 2026-07-10. The shares represent 3.77% of issued shares outstanding before cancellation. Following the cancellation, issued shares outstanding will total 13,210,000, with residual treasury holdings of 68,681 shares (0.52% of post-cancellation issued shares). The calculation of residual treasury excludes fractional-share acquisitions after 2026-06-01 and is based on treasury-share balances as of 2026-05-31.
